title: Virtual pump request (template)
symptom: The issue is a template for requesting new virtual pumps, with fields for pump type, bolus step, extended bolus step, extended bolus duration step, extended bolus max duration, temp basal style, temp basal step, temp basal duration step, temp basal max value, temp basal max duration, base basal min value, and base basal step.
evidence_quote: It's just the template for new requests in future (there is a link in doc for new requests of virtual pumps, it was associated to an old ticket in Milos repository)
